title: Needs improvement
text: Needs improvement. Nice pan, Can be used on both stove and induction ready. But... needs improvement. The lid handle gets hot as well as the handle, would be better if covered with plastic or silicone, or wood. The handle is to thin for such a large pan. It needs to be larger/wider in order for better handling when filled.. Otherwise very good.
